title: Cheesy Tex-Mex Rice Bake
subtitle: with Pumpkin, Capsicum and Corn
description: Elevate rice to 'main-dish status' with this veggie-packed family-friendly dinner. It's not a 'bake' in the true sense of the word, but to keep things easy-breezy, we've cooked everything on the stove, piled it into a dish, then flashed it under the grill to finish.

steps.text: Cook rice: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Put in a small saucepan with 310ml (1¼ cups) water, cover and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 13 mins or until tender and the water is absorbed. Turn off the heat and stand, covered, for at least 5 mins.

Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, peel the pumpkin and cut into 2cm chunks. Cut the capsicum into 2cm chunks. Remove the tough inner stems from the kale (see Cooking tip), then finely chop the leaves. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Coarsely grate the cheese. Drain and rinse the corn.

Fry veggies: Preheat the grill to high. Grease a 1L (4 cup) baking dish. Heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the pumpkin and capsicum, stirring occasionally, for 10 mins or until golden and tender. Add the kale and cook, stirring, for 2-3 mins until wilted.

Grill rice bake: Add the corn, garlic and 1½ tbs Tex-Mex seasoning to the veggies and cook, stirring, for 1 min or until fragrant. Remove the pan from the heat. Add the rice, season with salt and pepper and stir to combine. Transfer to the baking dish and scatter over the cheese. Grill for 5-7 mins until the cheese is melted and golden.
Serve up: Divide the rice bake among bowls and enjoy!
Make it yours: This Mexican rice bake is delicious on its own, but if you have any sour cream or avocado on hand, serve on top for extra goodness.
